title: Read the Red Words
mascot_lines: When something goes wrong, the computer prints an error message.
Errors aren't scary — they're little clues telling us where to look.
The most useful part is usually the very last line, plus the line number.
If we share the whole error with the helper, it can usually fix the bug fast.

tier2.rephrase: Find the part that names the problem.

tier3.nudge: Look for words like 'NameError' or 'is not defined' — those name the problem!
